issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method signature differs between artifacts: the problem statement (and the template's Main usage) specifies a no-argument method messageOnRide(): String, but the solution defines messageOnRide(String equipment) and the Pig/Seal implementations use that parameter. This mismatch prevents students from implementing the interface as described and makes the provided example usage in Main invalid (calling messageOnRide() with no arguments). It also changes the expected output format by including equipment text in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable interface consistent with the problem statement and template: change the method signature in the solution to String messageOnRide() (no parameters), and update Pig and Seal implementations to implement the no-arg version returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is required pedagogically, update the problem statement and template Main usage to document and call messageOnRide(String equipment) consistently.
